# Security Policy · 安全策略

LiveTranslateBridge captures app and microphone audio, stores your Model Studio
API key in the login keychain and streams audio to Alibaba Cloud. Problems that
could leak credentials, audio or transcripts should be reported privately.

LiveTranslateBridge 会采集应用与麦克风声音，把 Model Studio 密钥存在登录钥匙串，
并把音频发送到阿里云。可能泄露密钥、音频或字幕内容的问题，请私下报告。

## Reporting a vulnerability · 报告漏洞

Use [**Report a vulnerability**](https://github.com/hoobnn/livetranslate-bridge/security/advisories/new)
(GitHub private vulnerability reporting). Do not open a public issue, and never
include your API key.

请通过上方链接私下提交，不要公开发 issue，也不要附上你的 API Key。

You will get a reply within 7 days.

## Supported versions · 支持的版本

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/hoobnn/livetranslate-bridge/releases/latest)
receives security fixes. 仅最新版本提供安全修复。
